readonly.title: Attention
readonly.msg: This accounting is read-only. The bookings are made in Bexio.

expenseAccount.label: Default expense account
expenseAccount.helper: Account an expense is booked to when no OCR rule matches.

payablesAccount.label: Employee payables account
payablesAccount.helper: Account a reimbursement to an employee is booked against.

fiscalYearStart.label: Start of fiscal year
fiscalYearStart.helper: Month in which the fiscal year starts. 1 = calendar year. Decides which period a booking is assigned to.

deletePosition.confirm: Do you really want to delete this position? This cannot be undone.

key.label: Short code
key.helper: A short internal code for this position. It helps you recognize it in lists and reports.

usage.label: Usage
usage.helper: What this position is for, for example a membership fee or an admission fee.

type.label: Calculation type
type.helper: How the amount of this position is calculated, for example as a fixed amount.

label.label: Label
label.helper: The text a member sees for this position on their invoice.

source.label: Source of the amount
source.helper: Decides where the amount of this position comes from: a category price list, a flag, a rule, or entered by you by hand.

categoryList.label: Category price list
categoryList.helper: The price list the amount is taken from, per membership category. Only needed when the source is 'Category'.

flag.label: Flag
flag.helper: The member flag that triggers this position, for example a locker. Only needed when the source is 'Flag'.

rule.label: Rule
rule.helper: The stored rule that triggers this position, for example joining at over 25. Only needed when the source is 'Rule'.

amount.label: Amount
amount.helper: The amount in francs for this position.

accountKey.label: Booking account
accountKey.helper: The account this position is booked to.

vatCodeKey.label: VAT code
vatCodeKey.helper: The VAT code that applies to this position.
